description: A PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST with the No Data reason is advisory: this node still sends the data it has, and starts breaking the link only once that data is acknowledged and the link is clean.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ at 0. Link setup as cas/make-called-accept: the peer's PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST (Ed4) at 2000, our PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED out at 52000, and the link made when that transmission ends at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400): link_state linked and cas.first_data/0.0.1.3 (B-0215). The peer is recorded Ed4 (B-0408) and the 16-bit family is in force. The SIS of the Called node declares the soft link established too (A-0194). At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY (FSN 0) carries a PHYSICAL LINK BREAK REQUEST with reason 0, No Data (octets 60 00): cas.first_data stops and link_state closing (B-0244, B-0423), but the reason is advisory, so the DTS is asked for clean close with nothing held back (B-0249, B-0250). At 61500, during the burst, conn 1 sends an ARQ U_PDU 'ping' (priority 0, SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3, TTL 0): the soft link exists, so it goes straight down as an ARQ C_PDU (10 bytes: the S_PDU with TTD 61500 + 1296000000 ms and 'ping') and dts.ttd runs to its TTD. At 62000 the burst ends, not clean (an acknowledgement is owed and a C_PDU may start, B-0422): csma.vdcd_end 4000, then LBT rule 1 (K-0067) and 12000 ms of contention. At 78000 the C_PDU goes in one DATA-ACK (type 11, FSN 0, C_PDU START and END, DELIVER IN ORDER as the SIS asked, both window flags, RX LWE 1, no Ack Data: the acknowledgement merged, C-1128), 32 bytes, 2 blocks, EOT 20, then an ACK-ONLY copy of the acknowledgement it carried (15 bytes, EOT 10, C-1154) and 3 bytes of zero fill. dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts at 88350. At 96000 the peer's ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 1 acknowledges FSN 0: dts.ack_wait stops, the C_PDU is confirmed (C-0679) and dts.ttd is cancelled. At 97000, when the burst ends, the link is clean (B-0237, B-0251, B-0422): link_state breaking and PHYSICAL LINK BREAK with reason 4, No More Data, as B-0302 maps No Data (B-0423), octet 44. The burst's prediction (96000 + 10 x 500) is ahead: csma.vdcd_end 4000, then LBT rule 1 and 45000 ms; out at 146000, our C_PDU ID 1; cas.break from 151550. At 161000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK BREAK CONFIRM: cas.break stops, link_state unlinked (B-0286), and the SIS ends the soft link (A-0199). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly (25 bytes; EOT and reception window 10), C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus segment. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000 ms (K-0080).
